listing.name: 5.5e SRD Oracle
listing.longDescription: Explore the redistributable 5.5e SRD catalog, create and continue characters, and play rule-faithful battles. Guest play needs no account; standard MCP OAuth is offered only when you choose to save or recover a session.

mcp.authenticationRationale: Browsing and all guest character and battle play are anonymous. Standard MCP OAuth is requested only to save, list, resume, or permanently delete account-owned Play Sessions.

availability.rationale: The English-language SRD experience has no product-specific geographic dependency; the verified publisher must confirm countries it can legally support at submission time.

releaseNotes: Initial public release: anonymous SRD catalog, character, and battle journeys; recoverable guest sessions; optional OAuth-backed saved sessions; explicit retention and deletion controls.
contentBoundary: Redistributable SRD and visibly synthetic content only; no PHB+ authored identity or protected expression.
